1792. Box Volume Comparator

40

Medium

Box Volume Comparator
Problem Statement

Design a C++ program that models a 3D box using a class.

The program must demonstrate:

Function Overloading

Friend Function

Private Data Members

User Input-Based Execution

Requirements
Create a class Box
Private Data Members:

double length

double breadth

double height

Public Member Functions:

void setDimensions(double l, double b, double h)

Set dimensions manually.

void setDimensions(double side)

Overloaded function.

If only one value is given, treat it as a cube.

double calculateVolume()

Returns:

length × breadth × height

Friend Function

Create a friend function:

compareBoxes(Box b1, Box b2)

Compare volumes of two boxes.

Print:

If first box volume > second:

Box 1 is larger

If second box volume > first:

Box 2 is larger

If equal:

Both boxes are equal in volume

Input Format
type1 dimensions
type2 dimensions

Where:

If type = 1 → 3 dimensions follow (length breadth height)

If type = 2 → 1 dimension follows (cube)

Output Format

First print volumes:

Volume of Box 1: <value upto 2 decimal places>
Volume of Box 2: <value upto 2 decimal places>

Then print comparison result.
